entries.scope: Non-Windows Tauri GTK dependency branch retained in Cargo.lock
entries.release_impact: Not linked into the Windows x86_64 release target
entries.review_basis: GitHub Dependabot alert #1 remains open because the lockfile package version is 0.18.5; the Windows x86_64 dependency tree still has no glib edge. The non-Windows GTK branch now resolves a local copy containing the exact upstream fix from gtk-rs/gtk-rs-core commit b5a4071e439bef2b5eea76c3aa25e5ae84839e34.

remediation.change: VariantStrIter::impl_get passes the C out-parameter as &mut p

entries.required_follow_up: Re-evaluate when Tauri or its runtime dependency graph supports glib 0.20; then remove the vendor patch, upgrade the normal registry graph, and confirm Dependabot alert #1 closes.
